references.text: Rahab and her family were spared when Jericho was destroyed, just as the man from Bethel and his family were spared after helping the Israelites.
Jericho was struck with the edge of the sword, but Rahab's family was saved because she had helped the spies, paralleling how the man from Bethel was rewarded for his assistance.
Israel took cities with the edge of the sword, a recurring pattern in the conquest of Canaan.
The command to strike the cities in Canaan with the edge of the sword as part of the conquest.
Ai was struck with the edge of the sword, a similar pattern of conquest and destruction of Canaanite cities.
Rahab was spared because of her faith and help to the spies, an example of how faith and cooperation with God's people led to salvation.
